nina: Heads-up: SummitAI received invoice inv_202601_1101 and a copy inv_202601_1101-dup. One has missing 'reserved capacity' lines, the other includes them twice. Customer flagged in SUP-2405.

sam: links?

nina: https://billing.redwood.app/invoices/inv_202601_1101.pdf and https://billing.redwood.app/invoices/inv_202601_1101-dup.pdf

ops-bot: job invoice-generator 2026-01-10T06:12:01Z completed with warnings. logs: https://ci.redwood.app/jobs/2026-01-10-1101

oliver: quick DB check: ```sql
SELECT invoice_id, description, amount_cents
FROM invoice_lines
WHERE invoice_id LIKE 'inv_202601_1101%'
ORDER BY invoice_id, id;
```

oliver: results: inv_202601_1101 missing 3 reserved capacity lines (~$1800 total). inv_202601_1101-dup has those 3 lines but also duplicates them (so 6 lines). Looks like partial replay + merge conflict in batching.

tara: any payments?

nina: none. customer asks for corrected invoice and apology note.

sam: plan: lock tenant, run dedupe merge to canonicalize to inv_202601_1101-dup, remove duplicated reserved lines, void the incomplete invoice, issue credit for duplicates. Also add reconcile-before-send gate in pipeline.

ops-bot: incident BILL-419 created. linked INF-8234.

oliver: dry-run diff: ```diff
- inv_202601_1101: missing reserved capacity $1800.00
+ inv_202601_1101-dup: reserved capacity $1800.00
- inv_202601_1101-dup: duplicate reserved capacity lines removed (-$1800.00)
```

sam: re-run completed. created corrected invoice inv_202601_1101-R and credit cr_202601_0003. ledger LEDG-202601-SUM-3.

tara: I'll send customer note and mark ticket SUP-2405 resolved pending ACK.

nina: follow-ups: BILL-421 for idempotency key enforcement, QA test QAT-104.

ops-bot: artifacts: https://ci.redwood.app/artifacts/2026-01-10-1101-retry/diff.json

sam: closing loop. thanks team. :white_check_mark:
